name: connect-objects-reset
description: What: Atomic Connect setup on the Main instance: delete EVERY Connect strategy and service configuration (except the built-in File Repository one), then create the Main-track service configurations and the shared template-built strategies. Each remote provider's strategies are created by its own prepare (connect-strategies-<provider>-create); the Profisee to Profisee ones by connect-profisee-to-profisee-connect-objects-reset. Portal-built strategies must be rebuilt after it. Part of the one-time bootstrap: prepares do NOT run it (they start from the baseline). Why: A building block of the Connect pack; a test, setup or schedule workload runs it so its steps exist once. When: Never run directly once the pack is tested; its parents run it. Running it alone is safe only when its own Needs are met. Needs: workloads it runs: connect-model-connect-objects-cleanup, connect-service-configurations-create, connect-strategies-create. Success: Every step Succeeded or Skipped. If it fails: Run connect-preflight first; then open the first failed step, whose If it fails text names what to check.
globalParametersNotes: Each child owns its globals (a child global beats a parent global), so every child also runs on its own.
